lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 primary vertical white stripes observed across the lateral torso; spacing is non-uniform, with slightly higher density and tighter spacing in the posterior quadrant compared to the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One distinct Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 9th stripe from the anterior, splitting in the upper dorsal region toward the spine.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple abbreviated segments observed; specifically, the 1st and 3rd stripes from the anterior terminate in the mid-flank before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper-mid thigh show a horizontal alignment pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron mark visible on the nasal bridge; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; dark pigmentation on lower limbs with white bands immediately proximal to the hooves.
